name: @agfpd/iapeer-memory
description: iapeer-memory — peer memory for the iapeer ecosystem: vault, memoryd (index/search/MCP over HTTP), context fragments, role doctrines. The package IS the system; session surfaces are direct per-peer files merged into each peer's cwd. See docs/README.md.

scripts.preversion: bun run test && bun run typecheck
scripts.release: npm version patch --workspaces-update=false && npm run release:finish
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --workspaces-update=false && npm run release:finish
scripts.release:major: npm version major --workspaces-update=false && npm run release:finish
scripts.release:finish: V=$(bun -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("package.json","utf-8")).version)') && git -C .. commit -m "$V" && git -C .. tag -a "v$V" -m "$V" && (cd ../core && npm publish) && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.prepublishOnly: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || (echo 'release: working tree is dirty — commit or stash before release' >&2 && exit 1)
